project_summary: The final Task 148 Trusted Eval ledger finding against clean tip 334b622 is remediated on exact source/test commit d25f327 and tree 1386710.
summary: Strict RED/GREEN TDD now proves every attempt in a bound Trusted Eval ledger is contiguous, in-budget, officially issuable, individually signed, content-addressed, and lineage-valid before SQL-trigger or runtime completion can succeed.
project_decisions: The authoritative source/test target is main commit d25f3272ef7ed87674f6e3fe5c6d974af44e7a96 and tree 1386710e89156b0621fe49427cc431ab9c0174a3, directly parented by reviewed clean tip and integrated Task 148 evidence commit 334b622615cd66755d15011a1fa95cdecfc985d4.

The existing shared completion verifier remains the single SQL-trigger and runtime completion path; its Trusted Eval component now validates the entire initiative attempt ledger before selecting the latest row.

Attempts must be exactly 1 through the latest row and no greater than the immutable contract budget; every row must have an official terminal status, integer seed, canonical result digest, valid HMAC, active Trusted Evaluator operator provenance, evidence hash, manifest/content lineage, and nondecreasing official UTC creation lineage.
The latest ledger row itself must be completed; a later failed or abandoned attempt makes an earlier completed result stale and unusable.

No equality constraint is imposed across attempts for refs, seeds, evaluator principal identity, evidence, or status because TrustedEvaluator.record_run does not guarantee those values remain constant.
The official multi-attempt compatibility control varies terminal status, seed, and the final candidate manifest while completing successfully.
Independent review remains pending and no acceptance is self-issued.
